en: The postcard shows both its written/mailed back and the front image. The front displays a wide, tree-lined esplanade with grand 19th-century buildings on both sides, along with people walking and a horse-drawn carriage. The street is lively and urban, typical of a city center in Europe. The printed text at the bottom reads 'Esplanaden i Sundsvall.' The stamp and handwritten address are in Swedish.
